results.overview: No one comes close to the undisputed master of the macabre and suspense as Alfred Hitchcock. Indecisive and weak-willed George grows dependent on Lucy's guidance on everything from legal matters to clothing. As Lucy's time at the firm nears an end, she grows jealous of June and has second thoughts about leaving George.

results.title: Maid in Manhattan
results.overview: Marisa Ventura is a struggling single mom who works at a posh Manhattan hotel and dreams of a better life for her and her young son. One fateful day, hotel guest and senatorial candidate Christopher Marshall meets Marisa and mistakes her for a wealthy socialite. After an enchanting evening together, the two fall madly in love. But when Marisa's true identity is revealed, issues of class and social status threaten to separate them. Can two people from very different worlds overcome their differences and live happily ever after?
